turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why did Owen find out about the zero from his phone, in the middle of class?
I'm sorry? Owen found out from the gradebook, in the middle of class, and nobody called me. Who decided to enter that zero?
Like, actually tired. Do you sleep? Do you dream?
That's mine. Did anyone speak to Owen before the zero went in?
I ask because you said you came straight from court and you haven't once sounded tired.
I didn't say court. I haven't said where I came from. Answer my question, Hale.
